facts.fact: Devin federal usage-based pricing is measured in Agent Compute Units (ACUs), which the page describes as representing how much actual work the agent is doing.
facts.quote: Usage is measured in Agent Compute Units (ACUs), which represent how much actual work the agent is doing.

facts.fact: The price of each ACU depends on the deployment level, and according to the page IL5 is more expensive than FedRAMP High.
facts.quote: The price of each ACU depends on the deployment level. For example, IL5 is more expensive than FedRAMP High.

facts.fact: Usage-based pricing is shared across all Cognition platform deployments and products, so customers can move between commercial and federal deployments or between Devin Cloud and Devin Desktop.
facts.quote: Usage-based pricing is shared across all deployments and products on the Cognition platform.

facts.fact: Customers with existing CSP purchase agreements (AWS, Azure, Google) can burn down those commitments by using Devin through their existing accounts, according to Cognition.
facts.quote: customers are able to burn down their CSP commitments with their existing accounts through utilization of Devin.

facts.fact: Under firm-fixed-price contracts, Cognition's Scope of Work specifies the mission outcome, SLAs, and hand-off terms, and Cognition budgets a number of ACUs and man-hours needed to execute it.
facts.quote: Cognition will also budget a number of ACUs and man-hours required to execute the scope of work.

facts.fact: Under firm-fixed-price contracts, leftover ACUs after delivery are credited back to the customer under regular usage-based-pricing terms.
facts.quote: Following delivery, if there are any leftover ACUs, they will be credited back to the customer under regular usage-based-pricing terms.

facts.fact: Cognition offers usage-based pricing for platform access and firm-fixed-price (FFP) contracts for delivering mission outcomes for federal customers.
facts.quote: We offer both usage-based pricing for access to the Cognition platform and firm-fixed-price (FFP) contracts for delivering mission outcomes.

facts.fact: Cognition states that federal customers can purchase Devin through contract vehicles including NASA SEWP V and ITES-SW2, via partners such as Carahsoft, alongside marketplace options.
